overview.summary: The MCHA Farmdale Apartments project at 1219 & 1233 W Lincoln Street involves modification of conditions originally approved by the Planning Commission on June 26, 2025. The applicant requested removal of a required mid-block bicycle/pedestrian corridor and restricting cross-access vehicular easement between two newly created parcels to emergency and maintenance vehicles only. Staff recommended partial approval: denying removal of the bicycle/pedestrian corridor but relocating it to Parcel 2, and approving the restricted access easement modification. The Planning Commission held a public hearing, with no public opposition, and voted unanimously to approve partial modification per staff recommendations. The final decision leaves all other conditions intact from the original approval.

timeline.title: Planning Commission decision
timeline.detail: After public hearing with only applicant testimony, the Planning Commission deliberated and voted unanimously to partially approve the modification (approve restricting vehicular access and relocate bicycle/pedestrian corridor to Parcel 2), deny the variance to remove the mid-block corridor, and adopt the new condition for the relocated corridor. Public Hearing Summary
On December 11, 2025, the Planning Commission held a public hearing for this Type III
application. Testimony was received by the applicant and their consultants, and no testimony 
was received from the public. After closure of the record, the Commission deliberated, discussed

the Modification of Condition and Variance requests, and ultimately voted unanimously to 
approve the Modification of Condition, deny the Variance, and approve the new Condition which 
addressed the Variance application by relocating the public Mid-Block Pedestrian Corridor from 
Parcel A to Parcel B, as recommended by staff in the staff report. 
This MOC final decision document leaves unaltered all other conditions and attachments from 
the DR 25-02 final decision document of June 26, 2025.
